fusions.name: Gaff Pull
fusions.desc: Hooks the first enemy an arm meets, dealing 9 damage. It only strikes a target carrying one of your afflictions, and uses that affliction up.

fusions.name: Barb Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed arm tip that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at the full 6 tiles. The target moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Snag Their Eye
fusions.desc: Snags up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles and pulls them onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Caught Breath
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
